name: Scholarship Assistance (MP Taas / NSP / Fellowship)
description: Guidance and institutional approval for State Scholarships (MP Taas Portal for SC/ST/OBC), National Scholarship Portal (NSP), Central Sector Schemes, and UGC fellowships.
commonProblems: Meri scholarship nahi aayi
Scholarship ka paisa kab aayega
Scholarship renewal form verify karwana hai
NSP portal verification pending at institute level
MP Taas scholarship status checking
Bank account seeding / NPCI link issue
responsibleOfficeName: University Scholarship & Fellowship Cell / DSW Office
location: Room No. 12, Main Administrative Block / DSW Building
requiredDocuments: Student ID Card or Admission Slip
Income Certificate (Current financial year, issued by Tehsildar)
Aadhaar Card linked with Bank Account (NPCI seeded bank passbook copy)
process: Submit your online application on MP Taas (mptaas.mp.gov.in) or NSP (scholarships.gov.in).
Print the filled application form and attach all self-attested documents.
Get the form endorsed by your Department HOD.
Submit the physical copy at the University Scholarship Cell (Admin Block, Room 12).
The nodal officer will verify and approve the application at the institutional level.

name: Marksheet Error Correction & Duplicate Marksheet
description: Correction of student's name, parent's name, enrollment number, subject code, or internal marks discrepancies on semester marksheets, as well as applying for duplicate marksheets.
commonProblems: Marksheet mein correction karwana hai
Marksheet mein spelling mistake ho gayi hai
Marksheet kho gayi hai, duplicate marksheet kaise milegi
Internal marks absent ya zero dikha raha hai marksheet par
location: Examination Building (Pariksha Bhawan), Near Main Administrative Block
requiredDocuments: Written Application addressed to the Controller of Examinations (CoE)
Class 10th (High School) marksheet/certificate for name spelling proof
Forwarding letter/signature from your Department Head (HOD)
Challan/Receipt of the prescribed correction fee (from Finance Branch)
FIR copy and Affidavit (only in case of applying for Duplicate Marksheet)
process: Write a formal application detailing the discrepancy.
Get the application forwarded by your Department Head.
Pay the prescribed correction fee at the Finance Section or University SBI challan.
Submit the application with the fee slip and 10th certificate at the Examination Cell counter.
Collect the corrected marksheet within 7 to 15 working days from the counter.

name: Examination Form & Fee Portal Resolution
description: Assistance with semester exam form submission, ATKT/Back-paper registration, fee debit without receipt generation, and admit card download issues.
commonProblems: Exam form submit nahi ho raha
Exam fee pay ho gayi par unpaid dikha raha hai
Admit card download nahi ho raha
ATKT back paper subject list show nahi kar raha
location: Examination Building (Pariksha Bhawan), Ground Floor Counter
requiredDocuments: Transaction ID & Bank Debit Statement (for fee payment issues)
process: For payment glitches: Wait 24 hours for automated bank settlement.
If status remains unpaid, present transaction reference to the Exam Cell IT Helpdesk.
For course mismatch: Have your department course coordinator endorse your subject selection.
Re-generate admit card from the student portal after verification.

name: Bonafide Certificate & Character Certificate
description: Issuance of official Bonafide / Study Certificate for bank education loans, scholarship verification, passport applications, and student railway concessions.
commonProblems: Bonafide certificate kaha se milega
Education loan ke liye study certificate chahiye
Railway concession form verify karwana hai
Character certificate kaise banwaye
process: Obtain the Bonafide Application form from your Department office or Academic Section.
Fill the purpose (e.g. Bank Loan, Scholarship, Bus/Train Pass, Passport).
Submit to your Department Head for preliminary verification.
Get final seal and signature at the Academic Section (Prashasnik Bhawan).

name: Hostel Admission & Accommodation
description: Hostel room allotment, hostel merit lists, mess enrollment, and hostel rule compliance for university hostels (Tagore, Raman, C.V. Raman, Saraswati, Rani Laxmibai, etc.).
commonProblems: Hostel kaise milega
Hostel allotment form kaha jama karna hai
Hostel ki fees kitni hai aur merit list kab aayegi
Room allotment confirmation kaise hoga
location: Hostel Office Complex (Tagore Hostel premises) / DSW Building
requiredDocuments: University Admission Slip and Fee Receipt
Hostel Application Form with passport photos
Anti-Ragging and Hostel Rules Undertaking by Student & Parent
process: Apply online for hostel allotment on the university student portal post-admission.
Check the published merit list on the university notice board / website.
If shortlisted, report to the Chief Warden Office with original documents.
Pay hostel & mess fees via university challan/portal and receive room key allotment.

name: Central Library Membership & Digital Resources
description: Jawaharlal Nehru Central Library services: Library membership card, book issuing/return, e-journal access (e-ShodhSindhu, DELNET), reading hall access, and thesis repository.
commonProblems: Library kaha hai aur card kaise banega
Library timings kya hai aur Sunday ko khuli rehti hai kya
E-library access aur research paper download kaise kare
Book issue limit kitni hai
location: Jawaharlal Nehru Central Library Building (Opposite Arts Faculty)
requiredDocuments: Student ID Card / University Admission Receipt
Library Membership Enrollment Form endorsed by Department HOD
process: Collect the Library Membership Form from the Circulation Desk.
Fill your enrollment details and obtain HOD endorsement.
Submit at the Library Card section to receive your RFID Barcoded Library Card.
Borrow books (UG: 3 books, PG: 5 books, Research: 8 books) for 14-30 days.

name: Fee Payment Verification & Refund
description: Assistance with double payment reconciliation, fee refund on admission cancellation, and official fee clearance receipts.
commonProblems: Fee payment ho gaya but portal par update nahi hua
Account se paise kat gaye admission portal par pending hai
Double transaction fee refund application
location: Main Administrative Building (Prashasnik Bhawan), Ground Floor
requiredDocuments: Bank Account Statement / Debit Transaction Proof (with UTR Number)
Cancelled Cheque or Bank Passbook copy for refund processing
process: Wait 24-48 banking hours for auto-reconciliation.
If still uncredited, visit Finance Branch with bank debit confirmation.
Finance branch reconciles with SBI Gateway and updates the student ledger.

name: University Medical & Health Services
description: Free doctor consultations, basic diagnostics, essential medicines, first-aid, ambulance service, and medical fitness certificates for students.
commonProblems: University mein medical facility hai kya
Doctor consultation aur emergency medicines
Ambulance service campus mein kaise milegi
location: Health Centre Building, Patharia Hills Campus (Near Hostels)
requiredDocuments: Valid Student Identity Card (for free medicines & OPD registration)
process: Visit Health Centre OPD during operating hours (8:00 AM - 1:00 PM / 4:00 PM - 7:00 PM).
Show Student ID at the registration desk for free OPD slip.
Consult Medical Officer and collect prescribed medicines from the pharmacy counter.
For emergency medical ambulance, contact Health Centre Helpline: 07582-265825.

name: Anti-Ragging & Campus Safety Helpline
description: Strict anti-ragging cell, quick grievance response, 24x7 security helpline, and student counseling to guarantee a ragging-free campus.
commonProblems: Anti-ragging complaint kahan register kare
Campus security assistance
Online anti-ragging affidavit submission
requiredDocuments: Incident details / complaint letter (can be submitted confidentially)
process: Immediate Toll-Free National Anti-Ragging Helpline: 1800-180-5522.
Contact University Proctorial Board / DSW office directly.
Submit written complaint in the grievance box or via proctor@dhsgsu.edu.in.
Action is initiated immediately with strict confidentiality.

name: Student Grievance Redressal Mechanism
description: Formal institutional mechanism for students to raise concerns regarding academic, administrative, evaluation, or campus life issues without fear of prejudice.
commonProblems: Mujhe complaint / grievance register karni hai
Department level problem solve nahi ho rahi
Dean ya Vice-Chancellor grievance cell
responsibleOfficeName: Dean of Students' Welfare (DSW) & Grievance Redressal Committee
process: Step 1: Attempt resolution at the Department HOD level.
Step 2: If unresolved, submit formal grievance to DSW Office.
Step 3: Case is examined by the Student Grievance Redressal Committee (SGRC).
